title: Tier-2 DECISION form -- one decider's answers to its refuters and its decision on every survivor (R38, R39, R40; PM 2026-11-02)
x_purpose: The second funnel. pairs.json (pma_pipeline.py pair) puts every REFUTE of a surviving claim in front of the claim's author. Each decider files ONE form: an answer to each refutation of its own claims, and a decision on every tier-1 survivor -- stance, and on SUPPORT the timing (ACT_NOW or WAIT), ONE trigger with its timeframe, where it is wrong, and an optional market condition that voids the trade. Code (decide-timing) counts across all seven seats: <4 SUPPORT = not slated; ACT_NOW > WAIT = ADVANCE, else WATCH (a tie is WATCH). registrar.py validate --kind tier2 --pairs pairs.json --funnel funnel.json checks coverage.

answers.x_note: one per pair where this voice is the AUTHOR of the refuted claim; [] when none of my claims was refuted

text.x_note: quote the refuter's point in ten words or fewer, then answer with my own method's tests on the W/D/H1 grid

concede.x_note: true when the refuter's evidence is evidence MY method cares about and it stands

decisions.x_note: one per tier-1 SURVIVOR (funnel.json survivors), every survivor exactly once

timing.x_note: REQUIRED on SUPPORT. ACT_NOW = act on the trigger from today's session; WAIT = a condition must print first (pull-in, pause, volume) and the trigger follows it

trigger.x_note: REQUIRED on SUPPORT: the ONE trigger the PM should act on

word.x_note: contracts/condition_vocab.json word with a FIELD level, e.g. h1_close_above:bar_high, in_zone:ma_20, close_above:pivot_high -- never a number

tf.x_note: R39: the timeframe the trigger is read on

market_void.x_note: optional: the market condition that voids this trade, in words the alert loop can watch (e.g. 'SPY close_below put wall 750'); null when my method has none

x_registrar_extra_checks: answers cover exactly the pairs where this voice is the author (pairs.json); none missing, none extra
decisions cover exactly funnel.json survivors; no duplicates
SUPPORT without timing or trigger => REJECT; trigger.word carrying a bare number as its level => REJECT (D123)
text / wrong_if using a bracket as a disqualifier => REJECT (R1)
